intro: A full review of Sorn — three MICHELIN stars — with everything you need to know before you go: price, how to book/queue times, dishes to order, and how to get there
quickAnswerHtml: Sorn is a three-MICHELIN-star restaurant in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026, in the Sukhumvit 26 area. Budget around THB 7,800++, book Online via TableCheck, and get there easily via BTS Phrom Phong

blocks.html:
If you're going to tell the story of the MICHELIN Guide in Thailand, you have to start with Sorn, because this is the first restaurant in Thai history to climb to three MICHELIN stars, achieved in the 2025 guide, and when the 2026 guide was announced, all three stars remained intact. Behind it is chef Ice — Supaksorn Jongsiri — the owner who has held down 56 Sukhumvit 26 (Soi Ari) since 2018, with one clear mission from day one: prove that Thailand's Southern Thai food has enough standing to sit on the same fine-dining stage as French or Japanese cuisine without flinching. And MICHELIN agreed with him, loudly.

The meal at Sorn is a Southern Thai tasting menu of more than 20 small courses that gradually moves the story from the Andaman Sea to the rubber plantations and orchards of the South. The dish people talk about most is the Southern crab curry, which has become something like the restaurant's signature. The dining room itself seats only about 22, which makes every evening quiet, refined, and feel as if the chef is cooking just for you. The tasting menu costs THB 7,800++ per person (including 10% service charge and 7% VAT, that comes to roughly THB 9,180), while special menus done in collaboration with guest chefs range from THB 8,900 to THB 20,000. The restaurant is dinner only from six in the evening, and the dress code is smart elegant, fitting for an evening you've planned for.

Another detail that makes Sorn something of a legend is the booking process. With only 22 seats and the whole world wanting in, every month turns into a competition. The TableCheck system opens booking for the following month at noon Bangkok time on the 25th of every month (if the 25th falls on a Saturday, it moves up to the 24th). International guests have a shortcut: email reservation@sornfinesouthern.com from midnight Bangkok time on the 15th. The rules are strict enough that full payment is required in advance, cancellations or rescheduling are not allowed under any circumstance, and arriving more than 30 minutes late means the table is gone instantly. It sounds harsh, but once people actually sit down, many say they understand exactly why it's worth setting that alarm for this restaurant.

blocks.descHtml:
Budget per person is THB 7,800++ for the regular tasting menu; once you add service charge and tax, prepare around THB 9,180 per person, and full payment is required at the time of booking. The key condition to know before you book is that there are no refunds, reschedules, or cancellations of any kind. Arriving more than 30 minutes late means you forfeit your table, and the kitchen cannot accommodate shellfish allergies or vegetarian/vegan diets.

There are two doors to booking. The first, for everyone, is TableCheck, which opens booking for the following month at noon Bangkok time on the 25th of every month (moved to the 24th if the 25th falls on a Saturday). There are only about 22 seats, so you need to click the instant it opens. The second door, for international guests, is the email reservation@sornfinesouthern.com from midnight Bangkok time on the 15th, or call +66 99 081 1119. The restaurant serves dinner only from 18:00 (the official Instagram lists Sunday–Friday, closed Saturday — double-check the exact seating times on TableCheck). To get there, take the BTS to Phrom Phong then walk into Sukhumvit Soi 26 for about 15 minutes; if you're driving, you can park at the Four Wings Hotel for THB 50/hour, with a free shuttle to the restaurant.

faq.q: How do I book a table at Sorn in time?
faq.a: Book through TableCheck, which opens for the following month at noon Bangkok time on the 25th of every month (the 24th if the 25th falls on a Saturday). International guests can email reservation@sornfinesouthern.com earlier, from midnight on the 15th. There are only about 22 seats, so you need to click the instant it opens, and full payment is required — no cancellations or reschedules.

faq.q: How much budget do I need?
faq.a: The tasting menu is THB 7,800++ per person; add 10% service charge and 7% VAT and it comes to roughly THB 9,180 net. Special menus done with guest chefs run THB 8,900–20,000.

It's a Southern Thai tasting menu of more than 20 courses, entirely set by the chef. The dish people talk about most afterward is the Southern crab curry. Worth knowing: the kitchen cannot accommodate shellfish allergies or vegetarian diets.

faq.q: How do I get there, and what time should I arrive?
faq.a: The restaurant is on Sukhumvit Soi 26, about a 15-minute walk from BTS Phrom Phong, or you can park at the Four Wings Hotel (THB 50/hr, with a free shuttle). It serves dinner only from 18:00, closed Saturdays, and you cannot be more than 30 minutes late or your table is gone immediately.
